title: Spielberg: UFOs as future humans

tellings.quote: What if they're not from an advanced civilization 300 million lighty years from here? But what if it's us 500,000 years into the future?

plain: The director Steven Spielberg wondered aloud, on Stephen Colbert's talk show, whether UFOs might not come from a civilisation "300 million light years from here" but be "us 500,000 years into the future." The remark comes up on Michels's show in an episode with the musician Flying Lotus. It is the idea that the visitors could be our own descendants travelling back in time.
